rules: 7-9 um scans only (7.91-9.366 um), never the 2.4 um fine scans; the method reads CT only, and published meshes are used only as truth and training labels.

Split by scroll, about 90% of the truth area to train and 10% to holdouts (approved 16 Nov). Train: PHerc0139 (9.362 um), PHerc0172, PHerc1667 and PHercParis4 (7.91 um). Holdout-A: PHerc0814, 0500P2, 0841, 0009B, 1447, 0343P, 0800 (not counted).
Zone 'train': training labels only, never scored as a result. Zone 'val': PHerc0139 z 5500-5650 and PHercParis4 z 7680-7936, model selection only, never trained on.

Holdout zones are scored only with calibration.bench.score --holdout from a clean commit; every such run is appended to bench/holdout-log.jsonl in the outputs folder. Holdout packages are frozen and never rebuilt; their truth is used for scoring only.
A zone runs from z0 (inclusive) to z1 (exclusive), in level-0 voxels of its scan. Boxes are full cross-sections.

Version 1 (15 Nov): PHerc0139 z 5500-7000 dev with 500-slice buffers and the rest holdout-B. The packages PHerc0139-dev and PHerc0139-B keep their version-1 zone codes and are kept for scoring; under version 2 all of PHerc0139 except val is training data, so their scores are in-sample. PHerc0172-train (z 3072-3712, package version 1) is kept on disc.

PHerc0139-dev.role: Development band: z 5500-7000 dev, 500-slice buffers each side. 37 consecutive named windings w023-w059.

PHerc0139-B.role: Same-scroll holdout: the whole 9.362 um truth; only its holdout-B zones (z < 5000 and z >= 7500) are scored as holdout.

PHerc0814-A.role: Crushed scroll; v1 wrong-wrap 13-17%. 19 meshes, no wrap names.

PHerc0500P2-A.role: Open stack without a roll axis; most pressed truth of all controls (33%). 46 meshes, no wrap names.

PHerc0841-A.role: The only scroll stock Reader v3 never saw; 3 meshes with community ink labels (ink holdout).

PHerc0009B-A.role: 8.64 um beamline; 18 meshes, no wrap names; ink labels.

PHerc1447-A.role: 8.64 um; 15 meshes, no wrap names; Reader v3 never saw it.

PHerc0343P-A.role: 8.64 um; 8 meshes, no wrap names; First Letters scroll.

PHerc0800-A.role: 8.64 um; 6 small meshes (about 9 cm2); reported, not counted in the headline.

PHerc0172-train.role: Training only (7.91 um): the densest 640 slices of 53 meshes, 44 wrap-named.

PHerc0139-train.role: Training (version 2): the 37 wrap-named meshes w023-w059 where all of them are present (under 0.5% of windings missing inside the traced annulus); z 5500-5650 inside it is zone val, never trained on (labels from PHerc0139-val).

PHerc0139-train-low.role: Training (version 2), partial annulus: below z 3200 w035-w050 have not started, so 30-67% of the windings inside the traced annulus are untraced; the network sampler would teach those sheets as air.

PHerc0139-train-high.role: Training (version 2), partial annulus: above z 7808 the meshes end at different heights, 15-70% of the windings inside the traced annulus are untraced.

PHerc0139-val.role: Validation (version 2): model selection only, never trained on; the val zone of PHerc0139-train as its own package, so its labels file is separate.

PHerc0139-title.role: Training (version 2): the scan's only truth above z 8576, one unnamed title mesh (7 cm2) with no neighbour.

PHerc0172-train-4608.role: Training (version 2), 7.91 um: 53 meshes (w052-w095 and 9 unnamed auto-grown meshes of the inner turns); the band with the fewest conflict and order flags.

PHerc0172-train-5760.role: Training (version 2), 7.91 um: 53 meshes; the second cleanest band, 256 slices above PHerc0172-train-4608.

PHerc0172-train-9728.role: Training (version 2), 7.91 um: 53 meshes; the cleanest band of the upper half of the scroll.
